hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover & 360-Day Implied Volatility Super Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information propagates with friction along economic supply chains. When major customers exhibit strong returns (pv13_custretsig_retsig), suppliers experience delayed earnings expansion over subsequent weeks. Combining this with 360-day institutional call implied volatility premia captures structural demand while maintaining low mutual correlation with standard price alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if supplier margins are squeezed despite strong customer demand signals.

candidates.rationale: Supply Chain Customer Spillover & 360-Day Institutional Call IV

hypotheses.title: 3-Year LEAP Institutional Volatility Risk Premia (Market-Neutralized)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Institutions pay substantial hedging premia for ultra-long 3-year LEAP options (1080 calendar days). Market-neutralized cross-sectional ranking extracts pure long-horizon volatility risk premia with zero net market equity beta.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 3-year implied volatility chronically underprices realized multi-year equity volatility.

candidates.rationale: 1080-Day 3-Year LEAP Market Neutral Volatility Risk Premia

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Revere PageRank Centrality & Cashflow Efficiency Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms occupying high PageRank network centrality within the inter-company supply network possess pricing power, lower supplier switching risk, and superior cash conversion stability per unit of capital.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if central supply hub firms suffer systemic debt overhang.

candidates.rationale: PageRank Centrality Hub Power & Cashflow Conversion Efficiency

hypotheses.title: Idiosyncratic Variance Contraction & Forward EPS Surprise Super Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equities experiencing a sharp contraction in unsystematic risk relative to their 1-year baseline paired with robust forward analyst consensus revisions indicate institutional de-risking and fundamental quality.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if low unsystematic risk reflects corporate stagnation rather than stability.

candidates.rationale: Unsystematic Risk Normalization & Trailing EPS Yield

hypotheses.title: 180-Day Options Breakeven Asymmetry & Audited Annual FX Translation Super Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines institutional gamma support / upside breakeven asymmetry at 180-day tenors with audited 10-K foreign currency gains/losses normalized by corporate assets, eliminating quarterly noise and delivering low turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if breakeven spreads collapse under systemic market-maker liquidity withdrawal.

candidates.rationale: 180-Day Breakeven Asymmetry & Audited Annual FX Translation
